pages.title: Merger Ports
pages.text: A merger accepts items on three horizontal faces and sends them out through the remaining face.$(br2)When placed, its output points away from you. Route supply belts into the other three faces.

pages.title: Combine Lines
pages.text: Click the output face with a belt to start the outgoing section. Complete incoming sections on an input face.$(br2)The merger waits while its output is blocked. Upstream belts then queue behind it.$(br2)Choose an output belt fast enough for the combined supply.
